verdicts.reason: B breaks the monolithic `parse` into small, well-named steps (`parse_line`, `read_sections`, `apply_env`, `valid_name`, `unescape`) with a `Line` enum, removes duplicated name-validation logic, and updates env overrides in place instead of collecting keys and re-looking them up with `unwrap`, while behaving the same as A.

Version A splits parsing into focused helpers (parse_line, read_sections, apply_env, valid_name, parse_header) with no duplicated validation, while Version B packs header, key, env-override and required-key logic into one long `parse` function with inline repeated name checks and manual slicing that are harder to follow and change safely.
